phases.title: Implement filterProducts in src/utils/productFilters.ts
phases.notes: Implemented search (case-insensitive trim), category (exact match, 'All' means no filter), inStockOnly, and sorting (price-asc, price-desc, rating-desc). Build passes. Remaining test failures are pre-existing and require phases 2-3.

phases.title: Wire up event handlers in FilterPanel.tsx
phases.notes: Wired search input, category select, inStockOnly checkbox, and Clear filters button to call onChange with updated FilterState. Build passes. 3 sorting test failures are pre-existing (require phase 3 — SortSelect not yet wired).

phases.title: Wire up onChange handler in SortSelect.tsx
phases.notes: Replaced _onChange alias with onChange, and wired select's onChange to call onChange(e.target.value as FilterState['sortBy']). All 17 tests pass, build succeeds.

phases.title: Wrap setFilters in App.tsx to also reset page to 1 on filter change
phases.notes: Added handleFilterChange wrapper that calls setFilters(next) and setPage(1) together. Passed it to FilterPanel's onChange. Updated SortSelect's onChange inline to also call setPage(1). All 17 tests pass, build succeeds.
